native_report_all.behavior: runGates initially stops at the first failure; executor records gate results and then repeatedly runs slices of all remaining gates, emitting gate-advisory results, advancing beyond each advisory failure until the complete battery is covered. This removes the need for a separate manual battery.
native_report_all.root_monitor: Collect exact74 descriptor outcomes from the current attempt; all failures across gate and gate-advisory events are one grouped repair input. Advisory success never grants gate stamps.
